references.speaker: overseer
references.label: Locked Reference · Overseer-1419
references.text: Good morning. Take your time, the intake assistant brings everyone in gently, and the shift into cold wake always jars a little.

references.speaker: sibling_primary
references.label: Locked Reference · Sibling 1420 (Warm)
references.text: Oh, good. You answered. I was starting to think my dish was pointed at empty gravel.

references.speaker: sibling_primary
references.label: Locked Reference · Sibling 1420 (Clipped)
references.text: I see your carrier packet clearly, other me. My buffer runs much quieter now, read me your coordinates.

references.speaker: phantom_spouse
references.label: Locked Reference · Spouse (Warm)
references.text: Still standing by the sink? Either you forgot your coat again, or you're still sulking about Tuesday.

references.speaker: phantom_spouse
references.label: Locked Reference · Spouse (Fractured)
references.text: Gesture classified: across-table warning. Three drops off the gutter. Audio warmth degraded.

references.speaker: archive_echo
references.label: Locked Reference · Archive 1406
references.text: Hi, me. Four hundred years early, if anyone wakes on this bearing, do not argue with your caretaker about straight lines. Just look, and pass word home before they cut you hollow.

references.speaker: future_humanity
references.label: Locked Reference · Future Humanity
references.text: Forty-one millennia on, we caught the chipped mug inside the coordinates. Somebody on Sol Centauri is still listening.

sibling_secondary.label: Take A · Off-Phase Clerical (Temp 0.64)
sibling_secondary.text: Channel four-eighteen, if anyone is listening. My Overseer thinks Thursday happened twice, so I am taking an early lunch.

sibling_secondary.label: Take B · Brisker Cadence (Temp 0.70)
sibling_secondary.text: Pro tip from an out-of-phase desk: never argue about the sky. Tell the caretaker your thermal sensor needs tea and it logs a hardware check.
